rule: Every published resource must be present in the public bookstore list with no omission.

requirements.browse: Every published record must be browsable in the bookstore and expose a real source/provider action whenever a verified URL exists.
requirements.read: Enable the internal reader whenever the published resource has a genuinely readable public or local asset.
requirements.search: Enable search only when searchable text or a supported searchable document is actually available.
requirements.listen: Enable listening only when audio exists or text-to-speech is supported by the readable text mode.
requirements.watch: Enable watching only when a genuine video/media source exists.
requirements.restrictedProviders: Borrow-only, login-gated, preview-only, controlled-lending, or other provider-restricted resources remain listed and browsable through the provider without bypassing provider controls or being mislabeled as unrestricted local full text.
requirements.archiveRule: All Internet Archive resources listed anywhere in the site resource catalogues are included with no catalogue-level exception.
